This newsletter is growing up 🌱 — tl;dr: I’m adding a paid subscription plan! | 2020-04-07 | Tags: newsletter, leadership, strategy, career, growth, product-management
**tl;dr: I’m adding a paid subscription plan!**
This newsletter was always meant to be a little side-project while I looked for a “real job”, but after so much positive feedback, and continued prodding from readers and friends, I’ve decided to double-down and turn this into a real thing. 🎉
**Starting in two weeks, only paid subscribers will get this newsletter weekly.**
In addition, paid subscriber questions will be prioritized, plus they’ll get a few other goodies (see below). Free subscribers will now receive this newsletter only about once a month.
Whether you’re a founder, a PM, a growth lead, a manager, or just someone who wants to do better in their career,
**think of this newsletter as your personal advice column**
. Send me your questions, and in return, I’ll share actionable real-talk advice. It’s like having a personal coach, but for real cheap.
**✨ To thank you for being an early supporter, subscribe in the next 48 hours and get 33% off for the first year — just $100, or $10/month ✨**
[Get 33% off for 1 year](https://www.lennyrachitsky.com/subscribe?coupon=83a45af2)
Image from This newsletter is growing up 🌱
[Image from This newsletter is growing up 🌱](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!7FYx!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fbucketeer-e05bbc84-baa3-437e-9518-adb32be77984.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F838e31ff-4934-49e8-863d-f891f2c551ab_480x320.gif)
When I launched this newsletter six months ago, I had no real plan. I knew that after leaving Airbnb I ultimately wanted to start a company. Or maybe full-time advising. Or maybe just get another PM job. In any case, this newsletter was always meant to be a fun little side-project.
But while I wasn’t looking, this has turned into a real thing. And the feedback you’ve been sharing with me has been immensely gratifying 🥰
*“Your writings have had a profound impact on me”*
*“It’s easily one of the most valuable emails I get every week”*
*“Your posts have enabled me to accelerate my professional development”*
*“It's transformed the way I work with my team”*
*“It’s making me smarter”*
I’ve been deliberating this for a while, and I’ve finally come to the conclusion that I should give this a real shot.

2. Live AMAs with amazing guests

What will it cost?
**$150 per year, or $15/month.**
My expectation is that you expense this. My pitch to you (or your manager) is that
**if this newsletter can help you make**
***one***
**better decision each year, it’ll pay for itself**
. And if it doesn’t, you can cancel anytime.
For those of you that can’t expense it, or can’t afford it, I’ve got a deal for you. Just email me and let me know what’s up. We’ll work something out. I don’t want the price to be a financial burden on anyone.
✨
**If you subscribe in the next 48 hours, get the first year for only $100, or $10/month (33% off)**
✨
